actual_cards.name: Delina, Wild Mage
actual_cards.oracle_text:
Whenever Delina attacks, choose target creature you control, then roll a d20.
1—14 | Create a tapped and attacking token that's a copy of that creature, except it's not legendary and it has "At end of combat, exile this token."
15—20 | Create one of those tokens. You may roll again.
actual_cards.provenance: Scryfall metadata mirror (METADATA_ONLY; 3/2 legendary). Chosen because one attack trigger fuses target choice + d20 + token-copy + recursion: the densest RNG vehicle in the corpus. Q6 RULES_ADJUDICATION entry (COPY_CONTROL/RANDOMNESS/TRIGGERED_CHOICE).
